programme.title: The Travel Show

Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

But his investigations and his morals are disturbed by the behaviour of the islanders, especially their free sexuality and their worship of the pagan gods. He meets the island's leader, Lord Summerisle (Lee), who explains how his Victorian grandfather developed fruit trees that thrived on the island and on which the islanders have come to depend. But with May Day approaching, Howie unearths what he thinks is a sinister connection between Rowan's disappearance and Lord Summerisle's orchards. And this places him in extreme peril. With Britt Ekland as Willow, the innkeeper's daughter; and Diane Cilento as the school teacher. Shown here in the "Final Cut" version of the movie. Joe and other bystanders grab the trailing ropes but, one by one, they are forced to let go as the balloon ascends, except for one person who is borne aloft, before falling to his fate. programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond grills a whole meal over the flames with a little help from some indoor prep. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Haunted USA
programme.desc: Paranormal documentary series that goes on a supernatural road trip across the United States of America. Stopping off in some of the USA's creepiest – and reputedly most haunted - cities to see if there is any truth to the spooky stories and ghoulish tales.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: This series focuses on the dark underbelly of the American mid-west, its heartland. Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Addicted To Marriage
programme.desc: Addicted to Marriage follows the lives of four intriguing women who love to get married. Meet Monette, Shae, Amy, and Kecia, who collectively have been down the aisle a total of 20 times! Each marriage enthusiast is ready to say "I do" again, but are the men in their lives ready? Some of the women know exactly what they want in a future marriage while others struggle with their pasts. One of the brides-to-be has a list she refers to as the 'Triple A': attention, affection and appreciation whereas others grapple with revealing how many times they've said 'I do' because of their lurking insecurities of potentially failing at yet another marriage. The women know they trust quickly and love hard but the relationship highs are often met with intense drama and scrutiny by the men they love. Will their willingness for a happy ending with Prince Charming push the men in their life away or will they finally have the happily ever after they have been longing for?

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: Ruby & Jodi: A Cult Of Sin And Influence
programme.desc: When mom-vlogger Ruby meets Jodi, faith turns dark, ending in abuse.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant

Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: It's a foggy day at Ireland's Cork Airport and the pilots of Manx2 Flight 7100 are circling the airport waiting for the weather to clear. After controllers clear the turboprop commuter plane for landing, the pilots reduce their speed and descend, but the aircraft suddenly goes into a severe roll and crashes into the runway. It's the deadliest crash in Ireland in decades, and it's up to the Irish Air Accident Investigation Unit to figure out what went wrong. They soon discover the fog is only part of the story, and the investigation reveals a startling gap in aviation safety that has put passengers' lives at risk.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Pacific Southwest Airlines Flight #182 Boeing 727 On its early morning run down the California coast, PSA Flight #182 is arriving at San Diego's Lindbergh Airport. Warned that a Cessna is flying immediately ahead of them, the pilots of the 727 confirm they see the plane and are instructed to maintain visual separation. But just minutes later, Flight #182 collides with the Cessna and both planes crash into a quiet residential neighborhood below. With 144 people dead including 7 victims on the ground, it is the biggest airline disaster in American history and investigators must determine what happened and who is is at fault.

programme.title: X-Ray Earth
programme.desc: Beneath our feet, under trillions of tons of rock, lurk astonishing and deadly secrets. Earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions are all driven by hidden forces deep inside our planet. Now, using the latest scientific data from sensors and surface scans, we can x-ray the earth to reveal the dangers locked inside our planet.Using thousands of sensors and state of the art surface scan information, for the first time, we can create x-rays of the deep interior of our planet.

programme.title: X-Ray Earth

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry journeys across islands, mountains and olive groves to reveal why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. From sailing old trade routes through the Aegean to marvelling at the optical illusions hidden in the Parthenon, she explores how ideas were shaped by the dramatic landscape and how a mastery of maths, architecture and navigation fuelled a golden age of progress and innovation. Exploring the threads between ancient and modern Greece, she joins a family of olive farmers in Crete preserving centuries-old traditions, and visits the mountaintop monasteries in Meteora, where nuns safeguard classical texts. In the coastal town of Galaxidi, she's swept up in a riotous flour-throwing festival that blends ancient myth with modern identity.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam Central Station is a haven for the homeless. Due to a housing shortage, migration, and long wait times for mental health services, around 100 people hang around the station every day. Field workers Marieke and Fikret try to help people with ID, shelter, or a train ticket home. But that's not easy: many homeless people refuse to be helped. Warehouse worker Ron is at odds with the deposit machines in the station. Law enforcement officers Menno and Baran are dealing with an aggressive can collector. Manager Mike shows off the world's largest underground bicycle parking facility. On the day the so-called "orphan bikes" are collected—bikes that haven't been picked up after a month—he and his team have to step up their efforts. And that's not the only bicycle parking facility; a new one is being built under the railway line.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: Tracking the butcher: A father's mission to bring justice to one of the most feared members of the Taliban reaches a turning point when a teenage boy within his inner circle is captured during a raid. With this unexpected breakthrough and the aid of the CIA's most advanced covert tracking technology, agents close in on the elusive figure known as "The Butcher." What began as a distant mission for justice now inches toward a final resolution.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: Trial by fire: A newly appointed director of counterterrorism takes charge of the CIA's controversial enhanced interrogation program, determined to track down those responsible for the Sept. 11 attacks. As the hunt intensifies and moral lines blur, the director faces growing pressure from within the agency and beyond. When the top-secret program is ultimately revealed to the American public, the director must confront the personal and political fallout of choices made in the name of national security.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Throughout history, men and women have dedicated themselves to raking in as much wealth as possible; old money, new money, even blood money. But from Robber Barons to Mansa Musa of Mali; how did they get it and how did they spend it? And in the end, were they happier than the rest of us?

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Love has always been one of the great drivers of history - a drunk driver, without a licence. Yet love hurtles on, costing royalty their heads, generals their victories, and many of us our sanity. We explore why, from Liz Taylor to Attila the Hun; the pain is never enough to stop us looking for love.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: When cases run cold, police in 1970s U.S. call upon the services of Dorothy Allison — the most celebrated "psychic detective" of her time. From the kidnapping of Patty Hearst to the crimes of Son of Sam, Allison sometimes provides incredible insights. In the 2010s, John of God is a leading light of the New Age movement with celebrity followers. He calls himself a psychic healer, but those closest to the man know that the truth is darker than anyone can imagine. In the first century C.E., Jewish commander Josephus is captured by the Romans. Apparently using ancient prophecy for political ends, he tells his captor, Roman General Vespasian, that he is prophesied to rule the world. The consequences have far-reaching effects on human history.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: In 1953, a US Army scientist working on biological weapons, Dr. Frank Olson, falls to his death from his hotel window under suspicious circumstances. Almost twenty years later, the US government offers Olson's family a $750,000 pay-out, revealing that he died because of his involvement in a secret CIA experiment studying the use of LSD and interrogation—an offshoot of a series of mind control experiments called MK-ULTRA. Go behind the true extent of these secret CIA experiments and their casualties.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The shroud of Turin is one of the most debated archaeological artifacts in the world. Is it the burial cloth of the Christian messiah, Jesus of Nazareth, or is it an elaborate fake? Every time the evidence points one way or another, a credible counter argument is raised. In the collective imagination of the mid-20th century, jetpacks were the personalized transportation of the future. American engineer Wendell Moore really did develop and test a model for the military, so why don't we all have one? Buried for 2,400 years, a pair of beautiful cups are discovered in a grave mound made by Scythians, an ancient civilization of the Caucasus Mountains. What can the cups be for if they have holes in the bottom? And why are they solid gold?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Outside Draskow, Poland, an undocumented cemetery hundreds of years old is found in 2010 containing a woman's skeleton with a blade on her stomach, a stone on her neck and a green color in her mouth. Was this strange burial a precaution against the living dead? During the cold war, the United States developed a surveillance tool that was the first of its kind—code name: Project Corona. Did the shiny golden dome really help avert nuclear Armageddon? Countless literati have studied Shakespeare's plays for his profound prose, but what about for secret-coded messages? In the 1800s, Dr. Orville Ward Owen built a hulking wooden machine to do just that and concluded that Shakespeare was not who we think. Does his theory stand up to scrutiny?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to San Francisco from LAX, Pacific Southwest Airlines Flight #1771 is cruising high above the California countryside. Apart from some mild turbulence, the routine regional flight is uneventful. That is, until the pilots hear gunshots in the cabin. They report the gunfire to the tower and moments later, the aircraft falls into a steep dive and crashes into a remote field. With 43 people dead and a possible crime on board, investigators from both the NTSB and FBI must work together to determine what happened, who had a motive and access, and who the intended victim was.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Every year, flood risks increase. Across the globe, big cities are experiencing giant storm surges and extreme rainfall, overwhelming natural waterways and drainage systems, catastrophes that rewrite the rules for engineers. In Tokyo, a city already prone to natural disasters, giant rivers are being built underground to cope with raging torrents and typhoons. In Spain, the horror of the Valencia floods has taught authorities the importance of early warning systems when infrastructure fails. In New Orleans, the Army Corps has revolutionized storm surge barriers — but it took the worst flood tragedy in US history to rewrite the future.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the Morandi Bridge collapsed in Genova in 2018, it was more than a national tragedy. Its failure was a reckoning for engineers everywhere and a sobering reminder that every structure has a lifespan. In a world of increasing populations, changing traffic volumes and extreme weather events, how can we safeguard new bridges? Engineers for Genova's new bridge met the challenge, focusing on intelligent safety and advanced robotics. As Turkey builds the longest suspension bridge in the world, engineers push the limits with clever innovations, delivering a modern marvel that withstands wild winds, catastrophic ship collisions and Earth's seismic fury.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Israel, archaeologists investigate the truth behind one of the greatest discoveries in history: the Dead Sea Scrolls. Found in 1947 deep in the Judean desert, this remarkable haul of 2,000-year-old manuscripts includes the oldest copies of the biblical texts ever found. But no one knows who wrote them or why they were hidden. In this episode, investigators combine traditional excavations with revolutionary analytical technologies to uncover new evidence that could help solve these mysteries. Cutting-edge imaging techniques reveal hidden clues in the scrolls — which could help identify the authors — while archaeological discoveries in Jerusalem paint a picture of a brutal, destructive event that would tear apart the ancient Jewish world around the time the scrolls were hidden.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Since the dawn of humanity, we have looked to the cosmos to understand our world. In the lush jungles of Southeast Asia, Khmer King Suryavarman II commissioned Angkor Wat, an elaborate stone masterpiece devoted to Vishnu. With precise measurements embedded into its very foundations, this temple is an ornate blueprint of the Hindu universe. Across the globe, another structure in Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula stands in tribute to the heavens. A relic of the ancient Maya civilization, the Pyramid of Kukulcan displays the divine light of the equinoctial sun across its façade, while hiding sacred secrets beneath. In Ireland, a near-forgotten cairn harbors mysteries illuminated by the winter sun. Newgrange, an ancestral tomb built by neolithic farmers, is adorned with strange carvings and features a cosmic design centuries ahead of its time.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Naples, Italy, a centuries-old tomb at the Santa Maria la Nova monastery may conceal the body of Vlad the Impaler, the prince who inspired the legend of Dracula. Scholars debate whether the tomb is linked to the infamous ruler or simply its known occupant. In Israel's Judean Desert, the Cave of Letters reveals a haunting archive of survival: ancient manuscripts, bronze ritual objects, and the remains of 17 people. The cave once sheltered Jewish rebels and families. In Malta, the Hal Saflieni Hypogeum, a 6,000-year-old labyrinth carved by hand, shows astonishing architectural and acoustic sophistication. Part tomb, part temple, it may have been used for rituals. Finally, a cave in Kenya reveals the oldest human burial site in Africa — for a 78,000-year-old child — reshaping our understanding of early human culture, emotion and belief.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Italy, explorers uncover an immense tunnel system, revealing a vast subterranean world once thought to be catacombs or escape routes. Excavations show it was a self-contained infrastructure network. In Germany, construction workers uncover eight mass graves containing over 1,000 skeletons. Artifacts and records trace the site to the plague outbreak, when famine, siege and disease wiped out thousands. In London, archaeologists unearth the foundations of the city's earliest Roman basilica, built to symbolize imperial power. Demolished just decades later, the structure's rise and fall mirror the evolution of Londinium. In Denmark, Neolithic longhouses and a mysterious chamber reveal traces of early farming life. This site may have served as both a ceremonial center and a food storage system, offering a glimpse into Scandinavian society.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Kim Dynasty
programme.desc: "Nuclear Family" begins as the Cold War ends - and North Korea has lost Soviet patronage, and with it, the security it guarantees and the economic support that has sustained the country for nearly half a century. As Kim Jong Il takes complete control of the country, he also starts a nuclear weapons program. With the country's economy failing, his government makes counterfeit $100 bills, and sets up factories making crystal meth and other narcotics. He also employs a private sushi chef, and hosts lavish banquets and parties while the country continues to struggle economically - all while at the same time negotiating with the United States.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: Trial by fire: A newly appointed director of counterterrorism takes charge of the CIA's controversial enhanced interrogation program, determined to track down those responsible for the Sept. 11 attacks. As the hunt intensifies and moral lines blur, the director faces growing pressure from within the agency and beyond. When the top-secret program is ultimately revealed to the American public, the director must confront the personal and political fallout of choices made in the name of national security.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Air and Marine Operations in St. Thomas arrest a suspected smuggler and chase a vessel fleeing into British Virgin Island waters. U.S. Customs and Border Protection busts a mother-daughter duo smuggling large amounts of marijuana through Miami International Airport to the Caribbean. In El Paso, alerts from the K9 at the Sierra Blanca checkpoint lead U.S. Border Patrol agents to the discovery of drugs and guns in multiple vehicles.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: U.S. Coast Guard, Air and Marine Operations, and Homeland Security Investigations join forces in Florida to target a suspected human smuggling ring. In Texas, U.S. Customs and Border Protection inspects a truck loaded with construction materials and uncovers a cunningly concealed cache of cocaine - almost 200 kilos hidden in rolls of plastic. And at Newark International Airport, a rookie CBP officer is eager to undertake her first drug bust, though the substance in question is not quite what she expected.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: With the Coastguard in pursuit, drug traffickers throw their illegal cargo into the water to try and avoid capture. While working on another anti-drug operation, divers of the Special Unit for Subaquatic Activities must change plans quicky to attend to a potential drowning. And an illegal fishing boat takes cover in the darkness to try and evade capture.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A routine surveillance check of fishing boats has unpredicted consequences. A suspicious speedboat immediately raises a red flag at headquarters. An interception team is dispatched to investigate. In the Balearic Islands, Coastguard teams are confronted with an unexpected case of alleged domestic violence.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Zalgiris Kaunas - Paris
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Seekordne lugu viib meid Põlvamaale, kus kaheksat last kasvatava pereema Kristi suurim unistus on saada endale uued hambad. Pärast laste sündi muutus tema hammaste seisukord aasta aastalt halvemaks, kuid nende parandamiseks ei olnud Kristil piisavalt ressursse. Olukord muutus päris kriitiliseks aga 2016. aastal, kui tal tekkis lõualuus äge põletik, mis läks edasi põskkoopasse ja sealt silmakoopasse. Kahe nädala pärast tekkis põletik juba ajus.

Väärt ideid ja näpunäiteid jagub nii suvilasse, korterisse kui ka suurde majja ning aeda. Loome koos kodud hubaseks ja stiilseks! Saatejuht on Jaanus Koort.

programme.desc: Äge suhtesari "Rannamaja" pakub vaatajatele kuhjaga romantilisi suhteid ning pööraseid seiklusi! Kuus noort ja vallalist kolivad elama rannamajja ühe eesmärgiga – luua romantilisi suhteid ja leida omale kaaslane. Kui kokkukolinute hulgas sobivat paarilist ei ole, siis korraldatakse pidusid eesmärgiga leida kaaslane pidutsedes. Juba esimeses episoodis selgub, et osalistevahelised tunded võivad tekkida väga kiiresti ning sama kiirelt võib kogu olukord võtta ka dramaatilise pöörde.

Rochelle ja Reggie leiavad ühise keele võimukate Fidži emade teemal ja lepivad kokku ka teise kohtingu osas.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia

Lahutatud vanemad Hannah ja Craig tunduvad hästi sobivat, kuid "isanaljad" rikuvad meeleolu.

programme.title: Maailm täis luksust

programme.title: Mõrvad Prantsusmaal. Finistère
programme.desc: Tagasi oma sünnipaigas Bretagne'is, peab sandarmeeria kapten Morgane Ledantec tegelema päevavalgele tulnud inimluudega, kui tormi ajal kukub ümber püha tamm. Ohver oli druidist - õpetus, millesse Morgane'i pühendas nooruses tema ristiema, mõistatuslik Katell. Morgane, kelle kaasasündinud ja vahel häiriv etteaimamisvõime, mida ta on kogu elu endas alla surunud, hakkab uurimise käigus vähehaaval taas esile kerkima, peab juhtumi lahendamiseks ühendust võtma oma noorpõlvesõpradega ja näib, et kõigil neil on midagi varjata.

programme.title: Sassis
programme.desc: Eesti 2022 aasta parima teleseriaali preemia pälvinud komöödia "Sassis" on tagasi! Peategelase Evelin Kassi elu on nüüd veel rohkem sassis. Me näeme nii palju piinlikke vahejuhtumeid, kiiksuga karaktreid ja kiiva kiskuvaid inimsuhteid, et piss tuleb püksi. Evelini ja Velle abielu on karidel. Rivaalitsemine ja ärategemine käib iga asja pärast - olgu selleks raamatud, maja või lapsed. Naine aga ei kavatsegi lahutusjärgsesse depressiooni langeda: raevuka tarmukusega katsetab ta uusi rõivaid, suhteid ja kasvatusviise. Nagu ikka, mida rohkem sa pingutad, seda suurem on risk kõik veelgi hullemini sassi ajada.

programme.desc: Miss Marple'i kodukülla asub elama Ameerika filmitäht Masrina Gregg oma noore abikaasa Jason Ruddiga. Juba esimesel vastuvõtul mürgitatakse üks külalistest ja uurijatel on põhjust arvata, et mürk oli mõeldud näitlejannale.

programme.title: Murdochi müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Murdochi uurib lennuõnnetust, mille käigus piloot hukkus ning paljastub James Pendrickiga seotud nurjatu vandenõu.

programme.title: Murdochi müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Murdoch ja Crabtree võitlevad vanglast põgenemise ja pangaröövi järel teadetega kahurikäega robotist.

programme.title: Murdochi müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Murdoch ja Ogden röövitakse ning värskelt ametisse määratud inspektor Crabtree esimene ülesanne on nad üles leida.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: Gwenda Halliday kolib Inglismaal oma unelmate koju. Ent maja sisustades tekib tal aina enam tunne, et on siin varem viibinud ja peale kõige muu näinud pealt ka ühe naise mõrva. Miss Marple'i abiga selgub, et Gwenda oli tõepoolest varases lapsepõlves samas majas elanud.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Vikaar William Davenport ja kohalik inspektor Geordie Keating lahendavad 1950ndate aastate Grantchesteri külas kuritegusid. Keating läheneb asjale sirgjoonelise politseinikuna, sellal kui vikaar usaldab rohkem oma vaistu ning oskab tunnistajatelt ja kahtlusalustelt infot välja keelitada.

programme.title: Preili Scarlet ja Hertsog
programme.desc: Aardejahi juhtum toob Mosese tagasi Londonisse sooviga teemant maha müüa; Eliza tervitab tema tagasitulekut; Clarence teeb kõik, et tõestada, et on sama võimekas kui Moses, mis tekitab nende vahel pingelist konkurentsi.

programme.title: Marlow' mõrvaklubi
programme.desc: Kui keset äärelinna teed leitakse surnult mees, kellel pole dokumente ega sidet Marlow'ga, süvenevad Judith, Becks ja Suzie elanikevahelistesse saladustesse ja pingetesse.

programme.title: Mõrv väikelinnas
programme.desc: Maria Bannister naaseb Gibsonsisse, et leppida oma võõrandunud tütrega, lõpeb tragöödiaa, kui ta leitakse mõrvatuna oma üürikorterist. Alberg uurib juhtumit ja see võtab ohtliku pöörde.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline raamatupoe omanik ja endine spioon Book aitab 1950. aastate Londonis politseil keerulisi mõrvu lahendada. Noor endine vang Jack asub poes tööle ja saab sooja vastuvõtu osaliseks, ent hakkab peagi kahtlustama, et teda ei värvatud juhuslikult.

programme.title: Kuukivi
programme.desc: Racheli nõbu preili Clark saabub Verinderi majja ja räägib Franklinile sündmustest Londonis, kuidas Rachel ja leedi Verinder said uuesti kokku ning üks teine Racheli nõbudest ära rööviti.

programme.title: D'Urberville'ide Tess
programme.desc: Traumaatilise kohtumise järel manipuleeriva Aleciga üritab vaene maatüdruk Tess oma elu taas üles ehitada ja armub idealistlikku Angelisse. Kui tema minevik uuesti välja ilmub, katkeb nende armusuhe.

programme.title: Perekond Hardacre
programme.desc: Sam and Joe asuvad end tõestama dokkidel ning Mary navigeerib Leedi Emma plaanides heategevusliku teepeo jaoks.

programme.title: Perekond Forsyte
programme.desc: Jolyon nõuab, et tal lubataks oma isakohuseid täita, samas kui James püüab teda firmast välja puksida. Soames lubab Irene'ile, et nad kolivad Pariisi, et edendada naise tantsijakarjääri, enne kui nad abielluvad.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Jane naaseb Thornfieldi pärast pr Reedi surma ja hr Rochester esitab talle lõpuks abieluettepaneku. Kas ta võtab selle vastu?

programme.desc: Spade küsitleb kentsakaid naabreid ja saab lisateavet poisi salapärase ande kohta. Teresa jätkab uurimist üksi ning Jean-Pierre seisab silmitsi oma mineviku ja Philippe'iga.

programme.title: Miss Marple

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: Kariibi mere saarel puhkav miss Marple kohtub major Palgrave'iga, kes teatab, et kohtas siinsamas mõrvarit. Kui nüüd major sureb, ei usu miss Marple sugugi, et surma põhjustas infarkt.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Lenna talu
programme.desc: Kukele meeldib kõigi kanade tähelepanu. Ühtäkki on aga kanad võlutud lillest, mille Lenna just aeda istutas. Kukele on selge - konkurent peab kaduma!

programme.title: Karumõmm Pups
programme.desc: Seekord tuleb karumõmmil vembutuju.

programme.title: Numbriklotsid
programme.desc: "Numbriklotsid" on sari väikelastele, kus õpetatakse laulude ja sõnamängude toel numbreid tundma ning rehkendusi tegema. Matemaatika on tore - õpime koos liitma ja lahutama!

programme.title: Karu Karla
programme.desc: Vahva sari kolmeaastastest lastest ja nende parimast sõbrast Karu-Karlast. Karla on laste lemmikkaisukaru, kes ärkab ellu ainult siis, kui kedagi teist lähedal pole. Karla aitab väikestel põnnidel üle saada igasugustest hirmudest ja muredest, ning teeb seda parimal võimalikul viisil - killukese maagia ja kujutlusvõimega.

programme.title: Luise ja Oliver
programme.desc: Luise ja Oliver on õde ning vend, kes elavad oma tavalist õe ja venna elu. Mängivad põnevaid mänge, õpivad uusi teadmisi ja tunnevad huvi, kuidas maailmas asjad käivad. Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Laura Kõrvits, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Mina ja Miia
programme.desc: Miia on Carinal kliinikus abiks, kui sinna tuleb Niklas oma emaga: nad kurdavad, et nende hiir magab päevad läbi ja ei söö midagi. Selgub, et loomake on juba surnud, kuid Niklase ema kardab pojale tõtt rääkida. Miial tekib nutikas mõte, kuidas poissi säästa. Tsentoopias leiab Miia Mo, Juko ja Rioki rannast, kus nad ootavad Onchaod. Düstoopia on juba väga lähedale jõudnud ja sõbrad peavad kiiresti leidma viimase koostisaine.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika
programme.desc: Mida teha, kui sulle hakkab meeldima sama poiss, kes meeldib ka su parimale sõbrannale?

programme.title: Lucas
programme.desc: Näib, et aare on päriselt olemas. Kas Goossenside pere leiab tõesti hullu hertsogi kadunud aarde?

programme.title: Simm Nööp ja vedurijuht Luukas
programme.desc: Toredal väikesel saarel nimega Rahumaa valitseb kuningas Alfons Kolmveerand-Kaheteistkümnes. Siin elavad ka vedurijuht Luukas ja tema väike sõber Simm Nööp. Ometi on saar nii väike, et suuremaks saanud Simmile jääb siin kitsaks ja ta peab ära sõitma. Vedurijuht Luukas otsustab talle seltsi pakkuda. Sõbrad lähevad vedur Emmaga Mandala maale. Nad ei pelga ohte ja otsustavad vabastada printsess Li Si. Väikese Simmi ja vedurijuht Luukase tee viib läbi Mustade Kaljude, Hämaruse oru ning Surma Suu värava Tuhande Vulkaani maale. Teel kohtuvad nad iseäralike tegelastega - Mandala keisri koka Ping Pongi, näivhiiglase Tur Turi, loheproua Närihamba, poollohe Nepomuki ja kolmeteistkümne röövliga. Selle fantastilise seiklusfilmi võtted toimusid maalilistes kohtades: alustades Baierimaa mägedest ja lõpetades salapäraste, müstiliste paikadega Lõuna-Aafrikas. Filmi ilu ei seisne üksnes lummavates vaadetes, vaid ka ülima täpsusega loodud suurte maadeavastuste ajast pärinevates detailides. Animeeritud loheproua Närihambale on hääle andnud Hollywoodi veteran Shirley MacLaine, kes oma kinokarjääri tipul on mänginud ka koos Elvis Presleyga. Tänased vaatajad mäletavad teda sellistest filmidest, nagu "Mu kallis nõiamoor" (2005), "Laenatud kingadega" (2005) ja "Bernie" (2011).

programme.title: Homme põgeneme
programme.desc: Tobias, Rosabella ja Ekke on üllatunud kui märkavad, et Marta ei olegi põgenenud, vaid teeb kaasa hommikuvõimlemises. Marta tunneb ennast reedetuna ja on sõprade peale väga solvunud. Ta läheb lõpuetenduse proovides teistega veel rohkem konflikti. Kasvataja Lilli üritab Martat mõista ja talle toeks olla. Tobias ja Rosabella lepivad Martaga ära ja Tobiasel tuleb geniaalne plaan, kuidas Marta kiiresti koju jõuaks. Režissöör Kaire Russ, tootja Kassikuld OÜ.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci avastamas Itaaliat
programme.desc: Seekord seikleb Stanley Tucci Liguurias, mis on tuntud ka Itaalia Riviera nime all. Portofino peen õhustik, jõukas sadamalinn Genova, imeliselt kaunis Cinque Terre rannikuala... Siin kasvatatakse maailma parimaid oliive ja elatutakse mere rikkalikest andidest. Kõigele lisaks on Liguuria ka pesto sünnimaa.

programme.title: Küllakutse
programme.desc: Seekordses saates läheb saatejuht Kristiina Tuvi külla lauljatar Elina Nechayevale. Elina räägib avameelselt emarollist, elust ja muusikast ning viib vaatajad jalutuskäigule oma lemmikparki. Juttu tuleb ka tema suurest armastusest lillede vastu ning saate jooksul selgub ootamatu tõde Elina kuulsa Eurovisiooni kleidi kohta. Saatejuht Kristiina Tuvi, produtsent, režissöör, operaator, monteerija Kristjan Reinvee, toimetaja Marin Östman, tootja Paradise Agency.

programme.title: Enn Vetemaa kinovariatsioonid teemal "Püha Susanna ehk Meistrite kool"
programme.desc: Pealinna rohkem või vähem nimekad näitlejad ja lavastaja sõidavad kolhoosirahvaga kohtuma. Kohalikus kultuurimajas antakse etendus, tehakse kaasa üks peaaegu obligatoorseks muutunud saunaõhtu ja lõpetatakse päev või öö kolhoosi varietees, kus esinevad kolhoosi isetegevuslased. Et vahetult enne kolhoosisõitu on püütud ka etendust televisiooni tarvis salvestada, on kaasasõitjate hulka sattunud ka telerežissöör ja saatejuht. Ekstravagantsete tegelaste vaimuka dialoogiga avanevad elu-ja olupiltidega vaheldumisi psühholoogilised tagamaad - inimeste mentaliteet ning seda kujundavad tegurid, moraalsete huvide ja püüdluste kokkupõrge ühiskonna normidega. Koomika on segatud tõsidramaatiliste toonidega, olles ühtaegu nii meelelahutuslik kui ka kriitiline.

programme.title: Tähelaev
programme.desc: "Leib jahtub", "Moonika", "Las jääda ükski mets" - lood, mida paljud oskavad laulda unepealt. Vähem teatakse, et need lood kirjutas helilooja Andres Valkonen, mees, kes oskab olla korraga nii valguses kui ka varjus. Tema ansamblid Keldriline heli ja Väntorel erutasid noore publiku ja nõukogude ametivõimude meeli 70. aastate alguses. Edasi on tulnud eesti esimene rokkooper "Põhjaneitsi", filmimuusika ja edukad lauluvõistlused. "Tähelaeva" valgussõõri astub helilooja Andres Valkonen koos saatejuht Ruth Alakülaga. Režissöör Kalev Lepik, toimetaja Marika Kaasik, produtsent Kaia Häelme. Täna on Andres Valkoneni 75. sünniaastapäev.

programme.title: Metsa lugu
programme.desc: Enamik inimesi teab, et Amasoonia ja Borneo vihmametsi raiutakse maha, kuid vähesed teavad, et ka Rootsi põlismetsad on kadumas. Praegu on alla 10% Rootsi metsadest looduslikud, ülejäänud metsad on metsakultuuride kasvandused. Nendes monokultuuridest koosnevates metsades puudub bioloogiline mitmekesisus, sest puud raiutakse maha niipea, kui nad on küpseks saanud. Kuigi Rootsi metsandusamet esitleb end nii hooliva kui ka vastutustundlikuna, lubab iga maharaiutud puu asemele istutada kaks puud, siis põlised metsaökosüsteemid ikkagi kaovad. Filmile eelneb kommentaar.

programme.title: Vana aja asjad
programme.desc: Arhiivimaterjalidele tuginev sari, mis esitab tegelikkust ajavahemikul 1960-1985, eelkõige selle aja asju. Saade "Suvi ja puhkus" näitab, kuidas vana aja inimesed suvel matkamas käisid ja rannas päevitasid ning mida tehti EÜE-s ja EÕM-is.

programme.title: Piia seiklused
programme.desc: Väike orb Piia elab Udumäe linna tänavail. Kolme kodustatud nirgi abiga varastab ta trooni endale haaranud õela asevalitseja Tristaini lossist toitu. Kord valvurite eest põgenedes riietab Piia end printsessiks ja algab pöörane seiklus, et päästa kanakassiks (poolkana, poolkass) moondatud troonipärija Roland. Kuningriigis pööratakse kõik pahupidi ja Piia saab teada, et meis kõigis peitub midagi suursugust. Eesti vaatajate jaoks on filmitegelastele oma hääle andnud Johanna-Elise Kabel (Piia), Priit Öövel (Graubart), Mark Oja (Prints Roland), Aleksander Ots (Tristain), Piret Viisimaa (Nõid) ja Rauno Kaibiainen (Lõkerdaja ja Jobuke). Film on dubleeritud eesti keelde dubleerimisstuudios AVP Stuudio. Dublaaži- ja helirežissöör on Kert Laur. Eesti keelde tõlkinud Vivika Aleksejev.

programme.title: Homme põgeneme
programme.desc: Tobias, Rosabella ja Ekke on üllatunud kui märkavad, et Marta ei olegi põgenenud, vaid teeb kaasa hommikuvõimlemises. Marta tunneb ennast reedetuna ja on sõprade peale väga solvunud. Ta läheb lõpuetenduse proovides teistega veel rohkem konflikti. Kasvataja Lilli üritab Martat mõista ja talle toeks olla. Tobias ja Rosabella lepivad Martaga ära ja Tobiasel tuleb geniaalne plaan, kuidas Marta kiiresti koju jõuaks. Režissöör Kaire Russ, tootja Kassikuld OÜ.

programme.title: FIFA jalgpalli MM. Spain vs Saudi Arabia
programme.desc: Jalgpalli MM-võistluste finaalturniiri korraldavad sel suvel ühiselt Mehhiko, Kanada ja USA. Turniir kestab üle viie nädala ning esmakordselt osalevad finaalturniiril koguni 48 meeskonda, peetakse 104 kohtumist. Maailmameister selgub juuli keskpaigas.

programme.title: FIFA jalgpalli MM. Spain vs Saudi Arabia
Siin ja praegu
programme.desc: Jüri Aarma külaliseks on kirjanik Enn Vetemaa. Režissöör Helen Valkna.

programme.title: Teemaõhtu
programme.desc: Näkke on Eestis kohatud hallidest aegadest alates. Enn Vetemaa on tuntud ja edukas mitmel alal ja ilmselt ka väljapaistvaim naiadoloog Eestis, kes on näkkide uurimisele pühendanud spetsiaalset tähelepanu. Uuematest trendidest rahvuslikus naiadoloogias juttu tulebki. Korüfeele sekundeerib ja vestlust juhib näkkidega omal käel tegelenud Rein Hanson. Režissöör Marko Piirsoo TPÜ telerežii II kursuse tudengitöö aastast 1999.

programme.title: Uurimusfilm doktor Enn Vetemaa märkmeraamatute põhjal "Eesti näkid"
programme.desc: Näkid ja inimesed on lävinud aastatuhandeid. Nende üldiselt rahulikku kooseksisteerimist kirjeldab naiadoloogiline kirjandus, aga ka paljude rahvaste folkloor. On nad üldse olemas? Mitte keegi pole seni suutnud tõestada nende mitteolemist. Filmis esineb naiadoloogia professor, tutvustades põhilisi näkiliike: hiid-paljastissi, nutust kuldjuust, mehelemb-lõõritajat. Näkid jäädvustati põhiliselt Lahemaa rahvuspargis, aga ka Saaremaal, Endla rabas ja Lõuna-Eesti järvedel. Käsikiri Enn Vetemaa, režissöör-operaator Illis Vets, heli Jüri Sandre, muusikaline kujundus Mikk Sarv.

programme.title: Öised lood
programme.desc: Enn Vetemaa telenäidend Jack Ritchie jutustuse "Me veel vaatame" põhjal.

programme.title: Peapõrutus
programme.desc: R: Peter Landesman. O: Will Smith, Alec Baldwin. Tõsielulistest sündmustest inspireeritud draamapõnevik neuropatoloog Bennet Omalust, kes avastab töö käigus seose profijalgpallurite ajutrauma ja hilisemas elus tekkinud psüühikahäirete vahel, mis lõppesid sageli surmaga. Kuigi doktorist saab šokeeriva avastuse tõttu miljonite ameeriklaste vihavaenlane, kelles nähakse ohtu armastatud spordialale, asub ta võitlema selle nimel, et õiglus pääseks võidule. Emotsionaalse filmi peaosas särab Oscari-võitja Will Smith ("King Richard: kasvatades tšempioneid"), kes kandideeris rolliga Kuldgloobuse auhinnale. Filmi on lavastanud endine kirjanik ja sõjakorrespondent Peter Landesman ("Parkland").

programme.title: Segased
programme.desc: Sampo on venna pärast mures ja otsustab kirjandusõpetajale õpetust anda. Ööbik ketrab oma mõttelõngu.

programme.title: Segased
programme.desc: Mida külvad, seda lõikad. Papillon on trellide taga, aga kas ta on nii palju mees, et suudab isale vastu hakata?

programme.title: Kuningalaul
programme.desc: Hans Hindpere ja Heino Jürisalu laulud Enn Vetemaa tekstidele suvisel Saaremaal. Laulavad Marika Urb, Haili Sammelselg, Voldemar Kuslap, Anne Saller, Lea Sion, Ivar Johanson ja ansambel "Collage". Orkester Aleksander Rjabovi juhatusel. Osades Helle Pihlak ja Lembit Mägedi.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Lesed
programme.desc: Stiilne krimidraama. Filmi keskmes on neli Chicagos elavat naist, keda ühendab üks asjaolu - kõik nad peavad tegelema võlgadega, mille neile on kaela jätnud nende kurjategijatest abikaasad. Hakkajad naised otsustavad oma saatuse enda kätesse võtta. Sünnib ülimalt ohtlik ja keerukas plaan viia läbi rööv, mis annaks neile kõigile sõltumatuse ja vabaduse. Mängivad Viola Davis ("Koduabiline"), Liam Neeson ("Röövitud"), Colin Farrell ("Fantastilised elukad ja kust neid leida") jt.

programme.title: Langus
programme.desc: Mägironimismatkal juhtub õnnetus ning parimad sõbrannad Becky ja Hunter jäävad lõksu 600 meetri kõrguse teletorni tippu.

programme.title: Uus tütar
programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.

programme.title: Langus
programme.desc: Mägironimismatkal juhtub õnnetus ning parimad sõbrannad Becky ja Hunter jäävad lõksu 600 meetri kõrguse teletorni tippu.

programme.title: Liblikas
programme.desc: Üksildane liblikaid koguv leskmees leiab oma autost ühe naabri üheksa-aastase tütre

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Aeon Flux on salapärane palgamõrvar, kes töötab valitsust kukutada plaanivate mässajate heaks. Ta saadetakse mõrvama valitsusjuhti ja sellest hakkavad lahti hargnema räpased saladused.

programme.title: Projekt Almanahh
programme.desc: Sõprade punt leiab salajased joonised, mille alusel ehitatakse ajamasin. Isiklike probleemide lahendamiseks ja kasu saamiseks ajas rändamisel on aga ootamatud tagajärjed, millega ei osatud arvestada...

programme.title: Asjade seis
programme.desc: Põnevusdraama kongresmen Stephen Collins'st (Ben Affleck), kes vaatamata oma noorusele on teinud hiilgavat karjääri ja keda peetakse järgmistel presidendi valimistel väga tugevaks kandidaadiks. Ühel õhtul toimub aga kaks mõrva - surnuna leitakse tühine varas ja kongresmeni assistent. Esmapilgul seosetud kuriteod, ent mitte uuriva reporteri Cal McCaffrey (Russel Crowe) jaoks. Kuigi Collins on McCaffrey vana sõber, siis tuleb tal siiski alluda oma toimetajale, kelle hinnangul ei ole tõelisel ajakirjanikul ühtegi sõpra, vaid ainult allikad. McCaffrey asub koos oma partneri Dellaga (Rachel McAdams) juhtunud uurima ja jõuab ootamatult välja vandenõuni, mis ähvardab raputada riigi võimustruktuure.

programme.title: Näljamängud: Pilapasknäär - Osa 2
programme.desc: Ulmesaaga Katniss Everdeeni võitlusest Kapitooliumi diktatuuri ja president Snow vastu jõuab dünaamilisse ja pingelisse finaali.

programme.title: Anakonda
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilmi võttegrupp otsib džunglis peituvat inimhõimu, kuid satub hoopis koletisliku inimsööja otsa... Peaosades John Voight, Jennifer Lopez ja Eric Stoltz.

programme.title: Silm
programme.desc: Lapsepõlves pimedaks jäänud tütarlaps saab tänu doonori sarvkestale taas nägijaks. Kuid kelle silma ta sai ja millised kujutised salvestusid sellele enne, kui selle omanik hukkus?

programme.title: Reetur
programme.desc: FBI agent Roy Clayton juhib ohtliku rahvusvahelise vandenõu uurimist. Kõik juhtlõngad viivat tagasi endise USA erioperatsioonide ohvitseri Samir Hornini.

programme.title: Kutsumata külaline
programme.desc: Noorpaar ostab ilusa maja koos paraja maatükiga, aga endine omanik ei lase neid uude koju sisse.

programme.title: Mandžuuria kandidaat
programme.desc: Lahesõja ajal röövitakse sõdurid, kellele tehakse ajupesu, et neid kurjasti ära kasutada.

programme.title: Peaaegu kuulus
programme.desc: Režissöör Cameron Crowe oli ka selle poolautobiograafilise filmi stsenarist ja pälvis oma käsikirjaga Oscari. Film sukeldub 1970. aastatesse, mil Crowe ise oli teismeline reporter ajakirja "Rolling Stone" juures. Filmis tabab sama saatus William Millerit (Patrick Fugit), kes kirjutab ajakirjale ansamblist "Stillwater" ja asub koos nendega mööda Ameerikat tuuritama. Lava taga kohtub ta bändiga kaasa sõitva Penny Lane'iga ja tundub, et poisi õnn on täiuslik. Kuid ehk on täiskasvanuiga talle siiski liiga vara peale surutud, sest ringisõitmisega kaasnevad ka uimastid ja alkohol.

programme.title: Mansfieldi park
programme.desc: Jane Janei romaani ekraniseering. Vaesest perest pärit tütarlaps läheb elama onu mõisa ning peagi märgatakse tema ilu ja terast mõistust.

programme.title: Tristan ja Isolde
programme.desc: Film põhineb keskaegsel romantilisel legendil kuningatütar Isolde ja ülla rüütli Tristani ebamaisest armastusest. Tristan ohverdab oma tunded rahu ja ühtsuse nimel.

programme.title: Anonüümne
programme.desc: Pseudoajalooline kostüümidraama, milles seatakse kahtluse alla 17. sajandi kuulsaima inglise näitekirjaniku William Shakespeare'i olemasolu.

programme.title: Solist
programme.desc: Film, mille peaosades on Jamie Foxx ja Robert Downey Jr. räägib Los Angelese ajakirjanikust, kes sõbruneb uue artikli jaoks materjali kogudes andeka kodutu muusikuga.

programme.title: Allikas
programme.desc: USA 2006 ulmedraamaLavastaja: Darren AronofskyOsades: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark MargolisMis siis, kui saaksid elada igavesti? See on ühe mehe teekond eesmärgiga päästa enda poolt armastatud naine. Eepiline rännak algab 16. sajandi Hispaanias, kus konkistadoor Tomas (Hugh Jackman) asub teele Uude Maailma, et leida legendaarne "nooruse allikas", mis kinkivat igavese elu. Tänapäevase teadlase Tommy Creona pingutab ta meeleheitlikult, et leida ravimit vähi vastu, mis hävitab ta armastatud abikaasat Isabeli (Rachel Weisz). Rännates läbi kosmoseavaruste 26. sajandi astronaudina, hakkab Tom viimaks mõistma mõistatusi, mis on teda tuhatkond aastat vaevanud. Kolm lugu sulavad kokku ühes tões, kui kõigi ajastute Thomas - sõdalane, teadlane ja kosmoserändur - saab mõistma elu, armastust, surma ja uuestisündi.

programme.title: Sügis New Yorgis
programme.desc: Romantiline draama jõukast naistekütist (Richard Gere), kel tekib suhe endast poole noorema kaunitariga (Winona Ryder). Will plaanib Charlotte pärast esimest ühist ööd hüljata, kuid siis avaldab naine talle ehmatava saladuse - ta põeb eluohtlikku vähki. See valus pihtimus annab nende suhtele täiesti ootamatu pöörde.

programme.title: Edevuse laat
programme.desc: Suurbritannia 2004 romantiline draama Lavastaja: Mira Nair Osades: Reese Witherspoon, Bob Hoskins, Rhys Ifans Rebecca Sharp (Reese Witherspoon) kasvas üles Londonis, suures vaesuses. Tüdruk unistab juba varakult glamuursemast elust, kui ta seisus seda vaid võimaldaks. Peale koolist lahkumist, otsustab Rebecca Inglismaa kõrgkihtides läbi lüüa, vahendeid valimata ning peagi on Rebeacca tõusnud Inglismaa kõrgseltskonna tõsiste tegijate hulka

programme.title: Aiad
programme.desc: USA / Kanada 2016 draama Lavastaja:Denzel Washington Osades:Denzel Washington, Viola Davis, Stephen McKinley Henderson Troy Maxson (Denzel Washington) töötab prügiautojuhina 1950ndate Pittsburghis. Maxsoni unistus oli saada professionaalseks pesapalluriks, kuid kui profiliigadesse hakati mustanahalisi sportlasi lubama, peeti teda juba liiga vanaks. Luhtunud võimaluse tõttu kibestunud mees tekitab peres veelgi rohkem pingeid, kui rikub poja võimaluse kohtuda kolledžijalgpalli värbajaga.

programme.title: Räpane tants
programme.desc: Baby (Jennifer Grey) on Rahukorpusesse minekust vaid ühe elutu suve kaugusel. Lootes nautida noorust, kuniks seda on, saab Baby pettumuse osaliseks, kui suveplaanid viivad ta hoopis koos vanematega unisesse kuurordisse Catskilli mägedes. Baby õnn aga pöördub, kui kuurordi tantsuõpetaja Johnny (Patrick Swayze) värbab ta oma uueks tantsupartneriks ja nad armuvad. Baby isa keelab tal Johnnyga kohtumise ära, kuid neiu on võtnud eesmärgiks aidata noormehel suve viimasel suurel tantsupeol esineda.

programme.title: Milk
programme.desc: Lugu Harvey Milkist ja tema võitlusest USA geiaktivistina. Mees seisis geiõiguste eest ning temast sai California osariigi esimene avalikult

programme.title: Lindmees
programme.desc: 2015. aastal parima filmi Oscari võitnud pigimustades toonides komöödiafilm, mille keskmes on kunagine Hollywoodi superstaar Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton), kes aastakümnete eest kuhjas kokku kuulsust ja raha filmides, kus ta kehastas kõikvõimsat superkangelast nimega Lindmees, üritab pärast karile jooksnud abielu ja karidele jooksnud karjääri taas kord rambivalgusesse naasta - sedapuhku Broadway lavalaudadel. Esietendusele eelnevatel päevadel ei ole enam kuigi kerge leida asja, mis pole veel kiiva kiskunud ning lisaks teatritüki sünnivaludele peab mees pidevat lahingut oma muljuda saanud egoga ning üritab samal ajal visalt võita tagasi oma perekonda, karjääri ning eneseväärikust...

programme.title: Katkenud elu
programme.desc: R: James Mangold. O: Winona Ryder, Angelina Jolie. Oscariga pärjatud tõsieluline draama räägib 19-aastase neiu läbielamistest psühhiaatriahaiglas 1960. aastate Ameerikas. Susanna (Ryder) on suitsiidsusele kalduv ebastabiilne noor naine, kes pannakse ravile Claymoore'i psühhiaatriahaiglasse. Seal sõbruneb ta teiste patsientidega, sealhulgas mässumeelse Lisaga (Jolie), kes teeb Susannale ettepaneku koos haiglast põgeneda, et näha elu teispool "vanglamüüre". Kuid elul on põgenike jaoks teised plaanid. Filmi aluseks on Susanna Kayseni autobiograafilised memuaarid. Linateose lavastajaks on James Mangold ("Logan", "Indiaani Jones ja saatuse seier"). Peaosades parima kõrvalosatäitja Oscari ja Kuldgloobuse pälvinud Angelina Jolie ("Vahetus", "Pahatar") ja mitmekordne Oscari-nominent Winona Ryder ("Süütuse aeg", "Mardikamahl, mardikamahl").

programme.title: Armastushoos
programme.desc: Fitnessitreener Kate Wolf pühib Los Angelese tolmu jalgelt ning asub tööle oma parima sõbra tervisekeskusesse. Tema üllatuseks satub ta treenima filmistaar Rick Stelle'i. Intensiivsete treeningute käigus kaovad lisaks kilodele ka mitmed psühholoogilised seinad. Kui treenima saabub ka Ricki kaunis kaastäht, pannakse nende värske sõprus tõsiselt proovile.

programme.title: James May: meie mees Jaapanis
programme.desc: Teekond lõpeb Shikokul ja Kyushul - Jaapani suurimatel lõunasaartel, kus on sinine vesi ja liivarannad. Varuks on jalgrattasõit, vibulaskmine, nuudlite valmistamine ja mootorrataste tootmine, lisaks säilitatakse James hernehirmutiste külas igaveseks.

programme.title: Suvereporter+
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult.

programme.title: Suvi Langeoonil
programme.desc: Katrin soovib võimalikult kiiresti notari juures asjadega ühele poole saada. Isa, kellega ta pole 25 aastat suhelnud, ei ilmu kohale. Ka poeg Linust ja isa elukaaslast Levket pole võimalik kätte saada. Katrini kimbatus paisub vihaks. Otsides tundele ventiili, avastab ta enda jaoks Paco. Kas trauma üle elanud teraapiahobune on talle õige vastane?

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. Koos oma sõbra, roosa meritähe Patrickuga, satub ta kõige hullumeelsematesse ja põnevamatesse seiklustesse. Käsna-Kallel on väga energiline ja optimistlik iseloom, ning ta töötab kokana restoranis Krõbe Krabi, kus valmistab merepõhja parimaid burgereid.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi.
